# Week 3: Discussion Section
## Practice vector operations


### 1. Loading packages & data

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
```

```{r}
sb_protected_areas <- st_read(here("data", "data week 3", "cpad_super_units_sb.shp")) |>  
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_city_boundaries <- st_read(here("data", "data week 3", "sb_city_boundaries_2003.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

sb_county_boundary <- st_read(here("data", "data week 3", "sb_county_boundary_2020.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")

aves <- st_read(here("data", "data week 3", "aves_observations_2020_2024.shp")) |> 
  st_transform("ESRI:102009")
```

### 2. Find bird observations within PAs in Santa Barbara County

Find how many bird observations are within protected areas in Santa Barbara County and show how your output differs with a spatial subset versus a spatial join.

```{r}
# Spatial subset
# A filter - keep only the rows of sb_protected_areas that intersect at least one row of aves. The result is still protected-area
aves_PA_subset <- sb_protected_areas[aves,] # subset
nrow(aves_PA_subset) # 35

# Making a map
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_borders() +
tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(aves_PA_subset) +
  tm_dots()
```

```{r}
# Spatial join
# A join - keep every row of aves, and attach the attributes of whichever protected area it falls inside. The result is still bird points
aves_PA_join <- st_join(aves, sb_protected_areas)
nrow(aves_PA_join) # 500

# Making a map
tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_borders() +
tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
  tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(aves_PA_join) +
  tm_dots()
```

Make a 5 km buffer around the protected areas and subset buffered geometries to only those with bird observations

```{r}
# Checking units
st_crs(sb_protected_areas)$units # in meters

# Creating 5km buffer and subsetting geometries to those with bird observations
sb_protected_buffer_5km <- st_buffer(sb_protected_areas, dist = units::set_units(5, 'km'))
protected_buffer_5km <- sb_protected_buffer_5km[aves,]

tm_shape(sb_county_boundary) +
  tm_fill() +
  tm_shape(sb_protected_areas) +
    tm_borders(lwd = 1) +
    tm_fill(col = 'orange', alpha = 0.2) +
  tm_shape(protected_buffer_5km) +
  tm_dots()

```


### 3. Find PAs within 15km of Goleta
```{r}
# Subsetting sb_city_boundaries to goleta

goleta <- sb_city_boundaries |> 
  dplyr::filter(NAME == 'Goleta')

sb_protected_buffer_15km <- st_buffer(sb_protected_areas, dist = units::set_units(15, 'km'))
protected_buffer_15km <- sb_protected_buffer_15km[aves,]

```


```{r}
dangermond <- sb_protected_areas |> 
  filter(UNIT_NAME == 'Jack and Laura Dangermond Preserve')

danger_dist <- st_distance(goleta, dangermond)
```
